reliability_score_provenance: frozen v1 prediction-only five-fold OOF score; no reference-derived feature

method.estimator: one positive scalar temperature fitted by reliability-weighted image-balanced pixel NLL
method.case_weight: frozen v1 OOF reliability score, normalized to sum one in each fitting fold
method.pixel_weight: case weight divided equally across that case's 16384 pixels

low_reliability_quintile.ordering: ascending reliability score, then normalized path

regions.lesion_centered: reference mask plus Euclidean radius 8 model pixels

metrics: image-balanced NLL and Brier; 15 equal-frequency pooled-pixel ECE and MCE; all regions and per-category
hard_mask_check: bitwise compare raw_probability >= 0.50 with OOF_calibrated_probability >= 0.50; descriptive only
